CARGO_PILE.title: Cargo Pile
CARGO_PILE.description:
At the start of each turn,
an extra card is drawn from here.
Click to view the cards in your Cargo pile (in order).
INTOTHESPIREVERSE-LOAD_AMMO.title: Ammo
INTOTHESPIREVERSE-LOAD_AMMO.description: Once loaded, [gold]Ammo[/gold] may be fired at any time, dealing {Damage} damage to the last enemy you Attacked.
INTOTHESPIREVERSE-AMMO_BUTTON.title: FIRE!
INTOTHESPIREVERSE-AMMO_BUTTON.descriptio:
Spend 1 [gold]Ammo[/gold] and deal {Damage} damage to the last enemy you Attacked.
This does not count as playing a card.
INTOTHESPIREVERSE-ARTIST_HOVER_TIP.title: Art by {ArtistName}
INTOTHESPIREVERSE-CARGO.title: Cargo
INTOTHESPIREVERSE-CARGO.description: At the start of your turn, draw 1 card from your [gold]Cargo[/gold].
INTOTHESPIREVERSE-INDIRECTLY.title: Indirectly
INTOTHESPIREVERSE-INDIRECTLY.description: A card is played Indirectly anytime you do not play it manually from your [gold]Hand[/gold]. (Replays are Indirect.)
INTOTHESPIREVERSE-INSTINCT.title: Instinct
INTOTHESPIREVERSE-INSTINCT.description: Increases the HP loss caused by Bleed.
INTOTHESPIREVERSE-MODIFY.title: Modify
INTOTHESPIREVERSE-MODIFY.description: Changes a card for the rest of combat. A Modified card cannot be Modified again.
INTOTHESPIREVERSE-MUDDLE.title: Muddle
INTOTHESPIREVERSE-MUDDLE.description: Randomize a card's cost between [blue]0[/blue] and [blue]3[/blue] this turn.
